name: Tyrique Daniel
headline: SENIOR AI SOLUTIONS ENGINEER | AUTOMATION & INTEGRATIONS

Experienced in translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, integrating CRM and third-party platforms, automating operational workflows, and guiding products from discovery through deployment. Combines hands-on engineering depth with strong cross-functional communication across customers, product teams, and engineering organizations.
